hero.title: Urubuga rw'Ubucuruzi n'Indanga-cururuzwa
hero.subtitle: Rwanda na Afurika ku Isi
hero.description: Gushoboza ubucuruzi bukorwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga, kugaragara, n'iterambere binyuze mu rubuga rugezweho.

about.title: Urubuga rw'Ubucuruzi n'Indanga-cururuzwa
about.description: Amamazanonaha Ltd ni urubuga rw'ubucuruzi n'indanga-cururuzwa rubona kure, rwashyiriweho guhuza abantu, ubucuruzi, ibicuruzwa, serivisi, n'amahirwe mu rusobe rumwe rugerwaho na bose.
about.subDescription: Binyuze mu guhanga udushya n'ubunyamwuga, dufasha ubucuruzi kumenyekana cyane, guhanganira ku isoko neza, no guhuzwa n'amahirwe y'iterambere.

vision.title: ICYEREKEZO
vision.text: Kuba urubuga ruyoboye mu bucuruzi n'iterambere ry'ubucuruzi buhuza u Rwanda na Afurika n'isi yose.

mission.title: INSHINGANO
mission.text: Gushoboza ubucuruzi, ba rwiyemezamirimo, n'abaturage binyuze mu gutanga ibisubizo by'isoko ryo kuri interineti rigerwaho na bose.

services.title: Serivisi Zacu
services.description: Urubuga rwuzuye ruguhuza n'ibyo ukeneye byose - byose byizewe, bifite umutekano, kandi byoroshye kugerwaho.

marketplace.title: Kwinjira mu Isoko ryo kuri Interineti
marketplace.desc: Ahantu habugenewe aho abakiriya bavumbura ibicuruzwa na serivisi mu buryo bworoshye.

ecommerce.title: Ibisubizo by'Ubucuruzi bwakorerwa kuri Interineti
ecommerce.desc: Gufasha ubucuruzi bwifashishije ibikoresho by'ikoranabuhanga kugurisha, kumenyekanisha, no kwagura ubucuruzi kuri interineti.

marketing.title: Iyamamazabucuruzi n'Izina ry'Ikigo
marketing.desc: Ingamba zo kumenyekanisha zifasha ibigo gukurura abakiriya bakwiriye no kubaka izina.

promotion.title: Kumenyekanisha Ubucuruzi
promotion.desc: Iyamamazabucuruzi ryibanze ku bakiriya n'ingamba zo kugaragara kugira ngo wagure abakiriya bawe.

discovery.title: Guvumbura Amahirwe
discovery.desc: Inzira yo kubona akazi gashya, imishinga, n'ubufatanye mu bucuruzi.

trade.title: Guhuza Ubucuruzi n'Isoko
trade.desc: Gukuraho icyuho kiri hagati y'abashyira ibicuruzwa ku isoko bo mu gihugu n'amasoko mpuzamahanga.

brandVideo.description: Kwa Amamaza Nonaho, twemera ko buri bucuruzi bukwiye kubonwa. Urubuga rwacu rwashyiriweho kongera ijwi ryawe no kuguhuza n'amahirwe wategereje.
brandVideo.growthDesc: Gura bucuruzi bwawe vuba binyuze mu kugera ku bakiriya bakwiriye mu gihe gikwiriye.
brandVideo.discoveryDesc: Bonwa n'abakiriya bashakisha neza ibyo utanga.
brandVideo.founderSub: Icyerekezo cy'iterambere ry'ubucuruzi bukorwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda

partners.title: Twizewe n'Ibigo By'Indashyikirwa
partners.description: Twishimiye ubufatanye dufite n'ubucuruzi buharanira indashyikirwa n'udushya.

innovation.title: Guhanga Udushya
innovation.desc: Kwakira ibitekerezo bishya n'ibisubizo by'ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo tunoze ubucuruzi n'iterambere.

trust.title: Kwizera
trust.desc: Kubaka urubuga rwizewe aho ubucuruzi n'abakoresha biyumva batekanye.

professionalism.title: Ubunyamwuga
professionalism.desc: Gutanga serivisi nziza, ubunyangamugayo, n'ubuziranenge mu byo dukora byose.

accessibility.title: Kugerwaho na Bose
accessibility.desc: Kugira amahirwe koroshya kubonwa, kugerwaho, no gukoreshwa na buri wese.

growth.title: Iterambere
growth.desc: Kwiyemeza gufasha ubucuruzi kwagura aho bugera n'ubushobozi bwabwo.

partnership.title: Ubufatanye
partnership.desc: Guha agaciro umubano ukomeye mu kubaka intsinzi irambye hamwe.

howItWorks.title: Gukemura ibibazo binyuze mu guhuza abantu n'ikoranabuhanga
howItWorks.description: Abakiriya benshi bagorwa no kubona amahirwe yizerwa ahantu hamwe, mugihe ubucuruzi bwinshi buhura no kutamenyekana bihagije. Amamazanonaha Ltd ikemura ibi binyuze mu gushyiraho urubuga rw'ikoranabuhanga ruhuriza hamwe kumenyekana n'amahirwe y'ubucuruzi.

step1.title: Abacuruzi n'Ibigo Binjiramo
step1.desc: Ubucuruzi n'ibigo byo mu gihugu bishyira ku rubuga ibicuruzwa na serivisi bitanga. Imyirondoro yemejwe ifasha abakiriya gusobanukirwa ibyo ugurisha, aho ukorera, n'icyenza serivisi zawe zizerwa.

step2.title: Kwamamaza n'Iyamamazabucuruzi
step2.desc: Tumenyekanisha ibyo washyize ku rubuga binyuze mu bikorwa byo kwamamaza byibanda ku bakiriya n'ubusabane n'abaturage. Ibi bituma abakiriya bakwiriye bavumbura ibyo utanga iyo bashaka ibisubizo.

step3.title: Abakiriya Bavumbura kandi Batumiza
step3.desc: Abakiriya barashakisha, bakagereranya, kandi bagatumiza bafite icyizere. Kuva ku bikenewe mu gihugu kugeza ku bintu bidasanzwe, byose biboneka ahantu hamwe - bigabanya imbogamizi kandi bikongera icyizere.

step4.title: Abahanzi b'Ibihangano n'Abafatanyabikorwa Barunguka
step4.desc: Abahanzi b'ibihangano, abageza ibicuruzwa ku bakiriya, n'abafatanyabikorwa bunguka binyuze mu bufatanye. Dufasha guhuza amahirwe n'abantu bashobora gutanga agaciro - mugihe tugira ijoro ryoroshye kandi rishimishije.

step5.title: Ikoranabuhanga → Inyungu ku baturage
step5.desc: Ikoranabuhanga ryacu rihuza abaturage n'ubucuruzi. Umusaruro ni inyungu ifatika ku baturage - amahirwe menshi, ubucuruzi bukomeye, n'ubukungu bukura buyobowe n'abantu basanzwe.

whyChoose.title: Kuki wahitamo Amamazanonaha?
whyChoose.description: Duhuriza hamwe ikoranabuhanga rigezweho, ubumenyi bwimbitse bw'imbere mu gihugu, n'ishyaka ryo gukura kw'abaturage.

multiCategory.title: Kwinjira mu bice byinshi
multiCategory.desc: Guhanga ibikenewe bitandukanye binyuze mu rusobe rumwe ruhujwe.

digitalFirst.title: Ikoranabuhanga mbere na mbere
digitalFirst.desc: Rwashyiriweho isoko rigezweho aho kumenyekana n'ukwinjira bifite agaciro.

localRelevance.title: Ibikorerwa iwacu, n'imyumvire mpuzamahanga
localRelevance.desc: Kwibanda ku Rwanda mugihe twitegura amahirwe mpuzamahanga agutse.

growthSupport.title: Ubufasha mu gukura kw'ubucuruzi
growthSupport.desc: Kuvana ibigo mu kutamenyekana bikagera mu kuvumburwa no guhanganirana ku isoko.

campaigns.title: Ibikorwa Byacu Biheruka byo Kwamamaza
campaigns.description: Dufasha ubucuruzi gukura binyuze mu kuvuga inkuru zifatika kuri video kuri TikTok n'imbuga nkoranyambaga. Ibirimo byacu bituma abantu bagira amatsiko kandi bigatuma bamenyekana.

claudine.quote: Uru rubuga rwahinduye ubucuruzi bwanjye. Nageze ku bakiriya ntigeze kumenya ko babaho. Icuruzwa ryanjye ryikubye inshuro 3 mu mezi 6 gusa.

leonce.quote: Kwamamaza n'ukumenyekana nibyo byari imbogamizi zacu zikomeye. Amamazanonaha yatanze ikiraro twari dukeneye kugira ngo tuhuzwe n'abakiriya benshi kurushaho.

jeanne.quote: Kubona serivisi zifite ireme byatwaraga iminsi. Noneho mbona abanyamwuga bizerwa mu minota mike. Icyizere n'ubunyamwuga ntibigereranywa.
